traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The curate has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Raise the Dead (1/Day)
traits.desc: In a ritual that takes 8 hours, the curate touches a creature that has died within the past 7 days. That creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point. The curate can't revive a creature that died of old age.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The curate makes three Celestial Radiance attacks.

actions.name: Celestial Radiance
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Healer's Touch (2/Day)
actions.desc: The curate touches another creature. That creature regains 13 (2d8 + 4) Hit Points.

sb.name: Gray Ooze Glob
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.desc: Whenever a creature hits the ooze with a melee attack, that creature takes 2 Acid damage.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) Acid damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ivlis makes three Chaos Blast attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Sinister Command if available.

actions.name: Chaos Blast
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) damage. Roll 1d4 to determine the damage type: 1, Acid; 2, Cold; 3, Fire; 4, Lightning.

actions.name: Sinister Command (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature Ivlis can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn. While Charmed, the target has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Quick Disguise
traits.desc: Jacko spends 1 minute to disguise himself as a different Humanoid of approximately his height and weight. While Jacko is disguised, a creature that takes the Study action to inspect Jacko's appearance can make a DC 13 Intelligence (Investigation) check, discerning his disguise on a successful check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Jacko makes two Poison Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Poison Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: Jacko takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

sb.name: Kuo-toa Marauder
sb.senses: Darkvision 120 ft., Truesight 30 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kuo-toa has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Brine Slicer
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Slippery
bonus_actions.desc: The kuo-toa takes the Disengage action.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lizardfolk makes one Bite attack and one Bone Pike attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Bone Pike
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Poison Spit
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Narthus makes two attacks using Vile Mace or Fateful Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Vile Mace
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Fateful Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 120 ft. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of Narthus's next turn has Advantage.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Trigger: Pral is hit with a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: Pral adds 2 to his AC against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss.

actions.name: Needle Sword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Enchanting Bow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 40/160 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

actions.name: Heart Sight
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, Undead automatically fail the save). Failure: The sprite knows the target's emotions.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The sprite has the Invisible condition for 1 minute. This effect ends early immediately after the sprite makes an attack roll or deals damage, or if the sprite has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Vinx makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Sling in any combination.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the wight has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wight makes two attacks, using Necrotic Sword or Necrotic Bow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Drink Life.

actions.name: Necrotic Sword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Bow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Drink Life (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature within 5 feet. Failure: 6 (1d8 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the wight regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage taken.
